{"CommandLine":"Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationCore
$outDir = "C:\Users\brazi\.gemini\antigravity-cli\brain\71a6727f-24ec-41d6-9612-1cde0b8f78ae\scratch"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null
$files = Get-ChildItem -Path "C:\Users\brazi\Desktop\Plaidoirie -20261110T093755Z-1-001\Plaidoirie_" -Filter "*.heic" | Sort-Object Name
$i = 1
foreach ($f in $files) {
    $stream = [System.IO.File]::OpenRead($f.FullName)
    $decoder = [System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapDecoder]::Create($stream, [System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCreateOptions]::None, [System.Windows.Media.Imaging.BitmapCacheOption]::OnLoad)
    $encoder = New-Object System.Windows.Media.Imaging.JpegBitmapEncoder
    $encoder.QualityLevel = 85
    $encoder.Frames.Add($decoder.Frames[0])
    $outPath = Join-Path $outDir "page_$i.jpg"
    $outStream = [System.IO.File]::Create($outPath)
    $encoder.Save($outStream)
    $outStream.Close()
    $stream.Close()
    Write-Host "Saved $outPath from $($f.Name)"
    $i++
}","WaitMsBeforeAsync":10000,"toolSummary":"Convert HEIC images to JPG in scratch directory"}
